The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Blur (At Will).name: Blur (At Will)
spell->Blur (At Will).description: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

spell->Invisibility.name: Invisibility
spell->Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Revealing Light (At Will).name: Revealing Light (At Will)
spell->Revealing Light (At Will).description:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

spell->Light.name: Light
spell->Light.description:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

action->Master of the Fields.name: Master of the Fields
action->Master of the Fields.description: Where poludnicas walk, the crops grows rich and tall, and where the poludnicas bury their victims, the corn never suffers from blight or weevils. A field (usually a few square miles) where a poludnica is in residence never suffers from random accidents such as vermin or disease, and any checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} off the field gain a +2 circumstance bonus. A poludnica must spend a week in a place before these benefits occur.

action->Riddle Lover.name: Riddle Lover
action->Riddle Lover.description:
A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on a poludnica by using Nature ([[/act make-an-impression skill=nature]]), Society ([[/act make-an-impression skill=society]]), or a suitable Lore skill to pose a riddle or answer the poludnica's riddles. In addition to the usual effects of Make an Impression, a creature that succeeds at this check receives a +1 status bonus to saves against the poludnica's spells and sunstroke haze aura (+2 on a critical success). On a failure, they take a –1 status penalty instead (–2 on a critical failure).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.OFE5ASBprpHGoaFs]{Effect: Riddle Lover}

action->Noonday Demon.name: Noonday Demon
action->Noonday Demon.description: A poludnica loses their sunstroke haze aura while in dim light or darker and is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} while in complete darkness.

action->Sunstroke Haze.name: Sunstroke Haze
action->Sunstroke Haze.description:
10 feet. A poludnica is surrounded by a shimmering haze of light and heat. Any creature that enters or begins its turn in the emanation must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. Regardless of the result, the creature doesn't need to make further saves against sunstroke haze for 1 minute. During the hour when the sun is at its zenith, even if the poludnica can't see it, the emanation increases to 30 feet.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and is enfeebled 1 for as long as it's fatigued.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

action->Cornfield Passage.name: Cornfield Passage
action->Cornfield Passage.description: The poludnica ignores difficult terrain due to vegetation.

action->Harvest Dance.name: Harvest Dance
action->Harvest Dance.description: The poludnica raises their scythe in a whirling dance. The poludnica Strides twice. At any point during the movement, they make a scythe Strike against up to two different targets; if either of these attacks is a critical hit, that target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Puka.name: Puka
Puka.publicNotes:
A puka's true form is unknown to all, save perhaps the Eldest. These private and tricksy shapeshifters almost always wear another shape, and they're invisible when not transformed. Pukas most commonly appear as fine black horses with golden eyes, often in full tack, approaching unsuspecting mortals and enticing them to take a ride. When a puka succeeds in coaxing a rider onto their back, they launch into a gallop far faster than any horse could sprint, taking their unfortunate rider on a wild and terrifying—but ultimately harmless—journey before dropping them off exactly where they were picked up. They play similar pranks in their other forms: leading hunters on a merry chase through darkened woods as a fox or wolf, tempting late-night tavern goers as a beautiful humanoid, or taunting mortal animals as an uncatchable hare.

Any animal form a puka takes is covered in slick black fur. Even in their humanoid guises, their hair remains similarly shiny and dark, and they always include some tell-tale animalistic features, such as a horse's ears or a fox's tail.

spell->Bane.name: Bane
spell->Bane.description:
You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

spell->Bullhorn.name: Bullhorn
spell->Bullhorn.description:
You amplify your voice, loud enough for you to be heard easily at a great distance. For the duration, your voice can be heard loudly and clearly by all listeners within 500 feet, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. Despite the volume, this doesn't make your voice jarring or distracting. This doesn't increase the range or area of other auditory or linguistic effects, and physical barriers such as walls and doors still block or muffle your voice as normal.

Your loud voice makes it easier to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} others, and the acoustics assist in Performing at a large venue. You gain a +1 status bonus to checks to Coerce and auditory Performance checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} at a large venue. You can Dismiss the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.9yzlmYUdvdQshTDF]{Spell Effect: Bullhorn}

Heightened (5th) Your voice can be heard clearly up to 1,200 feet away.

Heightened (7th) Your voice can be heard clearly up to 1 mile away.

spell->Frostbite.name: Frostbite
spell->Frostbite.description:
An orb of biting cold coalesces around your target, freezing its body. The target takes 2d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target also gains weakness 1 to bludgeoning until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.DdqWMj7cuf4S1bgr]{Spell Effect: Frostbite}

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4 and the weakness on a critical failure increases by 1.

spell->Gust of Wind.name: Gust of Wind
spell->Gust of Wind.description:
A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you Cast the Spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it was flying, it takes the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

spell->Wall of Shrubs.name: Wall of Shrubs
spell->Wall of Shrubs.description:
You call forth a line of bushes native to the region to spring from the ground. The wall of shrubs stands in a line 60 feet long, is less than 5 feet tall, and is a foot thick, providing lesser cover.

Heightened (3rd) The shrubs are 10 feet tall and 5 feet thick, provide standard cover, are difficult terrain, and have a Climb DC of 15. The duration increases to 10 minutes.

Heightened (5th) As 3rd rank, but the shrubs provide greater cover and the duration is 1 hour. You can choose to form a ring of shrubs with a diameter of up to 30 feet instead of a line.

action->Unknowable Truth.name: Unknowable Truth
action->Unknowable Truth.description: Except when transformed with Change Shape, a puka is invisible and intangible, able to move through the Universe but unable to interact with physical objects or creatures except to speak. Even then, a creature must succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:20] check to hear an invisible puka's voice.

action->Change Shape.name: Change Shape
action->Change Shape.description:
The puka takes on the appearance of one of the following creatures: a Tiny fox, hare, house cat, or raven; a Small dog, goat, or humanoid (most often a gnome or goblin); a Medium wolf or humanoid (most often an elf or human); or a Large horse. The humanoid shapes always include minor animalistic features. The puka keeps their normal Strikes, though their hoof strike deals slashing damage instead of bludgeoning in shapes with claws.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Wild Bolt.name: Wild Bolt
action->Wild Bolt.description: The puka Strides five times. They can't use Wild Bolt again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Wild Bolt]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Wild Ride.name: Wild Ride
action->Wild Ride.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The puka is invisible or in the shape of a horse, and is not in an encounter

Effect The puka bursts into a run. Their land Speed becomes 90 feet until an hour passes, they stop moving, they enter an encounter, or they take damage, whichever comes first. Moving at this Speed nonstop for the full hour, the puka can typically cover 20–30 miles. If the puka bears a rider, that rider can't move from their mounted position or be harmed in any way until the Wild Ride ends. An unwilling rider can attempt to get off as soon as the puka starts moving, but must succeed at a @Check[acrobatics|dc:20] check or Reflex save.

Puntzelken.name: Puntzelken
Puntzelken.publicNotes:
A puntzelken is a short, stocky creature, roughly the size of an adult dwarf, and resembles nothing so much as an anthropomorphic egg. Puntzelkens are usually encountered near mortal settlements, where they seek out vantage points that offer opportunities to converse with passersby: bridges, fence posts, or walls alongside well-traveled roads. Despite their enthusiasm for social interaction, most puntzelkens come across as condescending and arrogant, seemingly engaging in conversation for the sole purpose of lording their knowledge over others.

Slow and uncoordinated, puntzelkens generally avoid combat, using their innate magic to flee if a confrontation turns violent. A provoked puntzelken, however, can prove a capable combatant, viciously pummeling enemies with the silver spoon-like implement they carry as a walking stick.

spell->Suggestion.name: Suggestion
spell->Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Translocate.name: Translocate
spell->Translocate.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

spell->Enthrall.name: Enthrall
spell->Enthrall.description:
Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

spell->Paralyze.name: Paralyze
spell->Paralyze.description:
You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Blistering Invective (At Will).name: Blistering Invective (At Will)
spell->Blistering Invective (At Will).description:
A heap of insults and invectives spew from your mouth-words so devastating your foes burn from the intensity of your diatribe. Your words deal 2d6 persistent fire damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. If the target doesn't understand the language or you're not speaking a language, it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half the persistent fire damage.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and takes the full persistent fire damage.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and takes double the persistent fire damage.

Heightened (+2) You can target two additional creatures, and the persistent damage increases by 2d6.

weapon->+1 Silver Spoon.name: +1 Silver Spoon
weapon->+1 Silver Spoon.description: This long piece of wood can aid in walking and deliver a mighty blow.

action->Falling Vulnerability.name: Falling Vulnerability
action->Falling Vulnerability.description: A puntzelken doubles any damage it takes from falling, before applying its weakness to bludgeoning damage.

action->Unstable.name: Unstable
action->Unstable.description: A puntzelken takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their DCs against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] them and to their saves against forced movement.

action->Confident Ramble.name: Confident Ramble
action->Confident Ramble.description:
A puntzelken's unwavering certainty is so strong that they sway the minds of others. The puntzelken spends 1 minute expounding on a topic related to one of their Lore skills, making obviously wrong claims. Any creature that pays attention or engages them in conversation must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. Regardless of the outcome, the creature is temporarily immune to Confident Rambles for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unconvinced and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its saves and DCs against the puntzelken's Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation skill actions for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unconvinced.

Failure The creature believes the puntzelken's claims for 1 minute. It can attempt a new saving throw if presented with clear evidence against the puntzelken's claims but can't attempt more than one save per piece of evidence. Failed saving throws don't extend the effect's duration.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

action->Curse of Fragility.name: Curse of Fragility
action->Curse of Fragility.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The puntzelken attempts to curse a creature within 60 feet. The target attempts a @Check[will|dc:22] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature gains the puntzelken's weakness to bludgeoning damage and falling vulnerability for 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts for 24 hours.

Critical Failure As success, but the effect lasts for 1 week.

Queen Sluagh.name: Queen Sluagh
Queen Sluagh.publicNotes:
A queen sluagh grows more powerful by devouring souls collected from underlings or drained directly through her proboscis. The muscular tongue inside is tipped with a cartilaginous, barbed quill that feeds the queen not only the soul, but the strengths of its owner.

A soul about to leave its physical body gives off a peculiar scent, usually unnoticed by mortal creatures. But the undead fey called sluagh can smell and track down its location with frightening ease. Unlike most fey, sluagh are undead, possessing strong connections to void energy and mortal souls. Sluagh collect the souls of those close to death and bring them to feed their queen.

Most sluagh appear bald-headed, with rounded ears, sharp teeth, glossy black eyes, and scrawny bodies. Their rib cages show through their skin, which is translucent and soft as velvet.

Sluagh can become ghostly and incorporeal for brief periods. They use this power to stalk their prey to great effect. Sometimes the glimpse of a sluagh is mistaken for a ghost sighting.

spell->Overwhelming Presence.name: Overwhelming Presence
spell->Overwhelming Presence.description:
You surround yourself with supernatural splendor, appearing to be a god or similarly majestic being, with an appearance, regalia, and iconography of your choice. Targets must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the outcome, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target must pay tribute to you two times. Paying tribute requires that the target spend a single action, which has either the move trait (as they bow) or manipulate trait (as they offer up a token in their hands). They must pay tribute at least once on each of their turns, if possible. While affected, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you and can't use hostile actions against you.

Failure As success, but the target must pay tribute a total of six times.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target must spend all its actions paying tribute, and they cannot take other actions until the tribute is fully paid.

spell->Visions of Danger (A Swarm of Slu.name: Visions of Danger (A Swarm of Sluagh Reapers)
spell->Visions of Danger (A Swarm of Slu.description:
An illusion of horrific creatures fills the spell's area. The creatures look like Tiny swarming monsters with a specific appearance of your choice, such as fiendish flies or animated saw blades. The burst deals 8d8 mental damage with a basic Will save to each creature that's inside the burst when it's created, enters the burst, or starts its turn inside the burst. A creature that critically succeeds at its Will save can immediately attempt to disbelieve the illusion. A creature that tries to Interact with the monsters or observes one with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. Creatures that disbelieve the illusion take no damage from the illusion thereafter.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 1d8

spell->Invisibility (At Will).name: Invisibility (At Will)
spell->Invisibility (At Will).description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Figment.name: Figment
spell->Figment.description:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

action->Soulscent (Imprecise) 200 feet.name: Soulscent (Imprecise) 200 feet
action->Soulscent (Imprecise) 200 feet.description: The sluagh is aware of all doomed creatures, dying creatures, and creatures that died within the last hour within the listed range.

action->Voice of the Soul.name: Voice of the Soul
action->Voice of the Soul.description: A sluagh queen knows any language of a creature whose soul they've devoured and can perfectly mimic its voice by attempting a Deception check to [[/act lie options=voice-of-the-soul]], with a +4 circumstance bonus.

action->Call of the Damned.name: Call of the Damned
action->Call of the Damned.description: The queen sends out shriek to all sluagh within 1 mile, summoning them to her. This typically calls [[/r 2d4]] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.uURI8Netd0ytD9vc]{Sluagh Reapers}. If the queen is facing foes strong enough to threaten her, these are likely too weak to pose a threat but can assist by fetching items or getting in enemies' way.

action->Eat Soul.name: Eat Soul
action->Eat Soul.description: The queen touches a dying creature or a creature that died within the past 1 hour with her proboscis. If the target is dying, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save; on a failure, its dying value increases by 2 (3 on a critical failure). If the target is dead, the queen automatically devours its soul. Unless the queen is destroyed, the target can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual.

action->Ghostly Swoop.name: Ghostly Swoop
action->Ghostly Swoop.description: The queen sluagh becomes incorporeal until the start of their next turn, and Flies up to their fly Speed. While incorporeal, they are immune to precision damage, and have resistance 10 to all damage (except force, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}, or vitality); this resistance is doubled against non-magical damage.The sluagh queen can't use Ghostly Swoop again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Ghostly Swoop]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Soul Theft.name: Soul Theft
action->Soul Theft.description:
Requirements The queen has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with her proboscis

Effect The queen devours a portion of the required creature's soul and steals some of its ability. The target attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save. The queen gains temporary HP equal to the total amount of HP the target loses from the result of its save, including any HP lost from being drained.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[5d8[void]] damage and is drained 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. The queen steals a spell slot or training. If she steals a spell from a prepared caster, she transfers the spell to herself; if she steals from a spontaneous caster, she gains a prepared spell of the appropriate level and expends one of the creature's spell slots of that level. If she steals training, she chooses from the target's Perception, attack modifier, or any skill. For 24 hours, she gains a +2 status bonus to that statistic, and the target takes a –2 status penalty to it. The queen can have any number of stolen abilities, but only one from each creature.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage.

Remacera.name: Remacera
Remacera.publicNotes:
Remaceras are mysterious fey who represent the natural cycle of transformative rebirth and metamorphosis. They believe that the cycle of reincarnation is the greatest expression of rebirth and revel in opportunities to send other creatures down this path. To a remacera, acts of violence are akin to scavengers and bacteria helping dead organisms decompose—and there may be some truth to this, as it isn't uncommon to find strange blossoms and fruits in their wake.

Remaceras take the form of enormous caterpillars with striking patterns and serene human faces. Their calm visages are shattered when they stretch their jaws unnaturally wide to reveal a mouthful of deadly, sharklike teeth, which vibrate at high frequencies to damage and disorient foes. The most ancient remaceras can grow as long as 13 feet and weigh thousands of pounds.

Despite their violent proclivities, remaceras savor the opportunity to have profound conversations with intelligent creatures. They seldom hold those who slay them in contempt, for they too receive renewal in death. Those who undergo a crisis of belief and turn nihilistic return as escorites.

action->Destined Renewal.name: Destined Renewal
action->Destined Renewal.description: A remacera is permanently affected by their own curse of renewal. When a remacera dies, after 1 minute, their new body appears [[/r 1d20]] miles from where they died. They can also choose to retain their current form.

action->Curse of Renewal.name: Curse of Renewal
action->Curse of Renewal.description: A creature damaged by a remacera's jaws must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:24] save or be afflicted with the curse of renewal. A creature that dies while affected by this curse is subjected to the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate} ritual that takes effect after 1 minute, regardless of whether the soul is willing to return.

action->Murderous Rhapsody.name: Murderous Rhapsody
action->Murderous Rhapsody.description: hen a creature the remacera reduced to 0 Hit Points dies, the remacera gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for as long as they have these temporary Hit Points. They can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

action->New Growth.name: New Growth
action->New Growth.description:
The remacera spawns tiny, larval remaceras within a creature they can see within 100 feet. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round as some larvae spawn on its skin before harmlessly falling off.

Failure As success, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} as several larvae burrow out of its skin.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while it remains sickened.

action->Ultrasonic Ululation.name: Ultrasonic Ululation
action->Ultrasonic Ululation.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The remacera has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in their jaws

Effect The creature takes @Damage[(2d10+8)[sonic]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save. A creature that fails is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).

Risen Fetch.name: Risen Fetch
Risen Fetch.publicNotes:
Echoes of a corrupted undead soul can be used to spawn a fetch as well. A risen fetch appears more as their source did in life than as an undead.

A fetch is a twisted, deviant simulacrum of a humanoid creature that exists or existed at one point on the Universe. While there are rumors of fetches who are reflections of beings from other planes, if such exist, they must still be duplicates of a sapient creature. A fetch can manifest spontaneously when a powerful person undergoes a significant emotional event or dies, either while in the First World or in an area significantly influenced by that plane. However, they've also been created by potent entities like the Eldest to torment and vex those who've annoyed them. While a fetch manifests from a soul's "reflection," and as such bears a striking resemblance to that soul's appearance, they have no true memories of their own. They hold fragments of false remembrances from their source, as if they experienced them in a half-remembered dream—which ensures the fetch is enraged by and jealous of their original.

A fetch is similar in appearance to the creature whose soul spawned them, except that they often possess fey-like features such as pointed ears, plant elements, or supernatural grace. A fetch who seeks to impersonate a still-living source must take care to hide these features and manifest a fetch weapon that their living template wields.

When a fetch dies, they fade away along with all of their manifested items into a bloom of plant life, their soul instantly recycled into the First World, leaving behind a patch of weeds and thorny flowers roughly in the shape they held while alive.
Risen Fetch.saveDetails: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

spell->Manifestation.name: Manifestation
spell->Manifestation.description: You spin secrets from the fundaments of magic, shaping them into a power with nearly unlimited potential. You duplicate a spell of 9th rank or lower of the tradition from which you cast manifestation, or a spell of 7th rank or lower from any tradition. Though you can normally choose only spells that are common or to which you have access, the GM might allow broader options.

spell->Overwhelming Presence.name: Overwhelming Presence
spell->Overwhelming Presence.description:
You surround yourself with supernatural splendor, appearing to be a god or similarly majestic being, with an appearance, regalia, and iconography of your choice. Targets must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the outcome, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target must pay tribute to you two times. Paying tribute requires that the target spend a single action, which has either the move trait (as they bow) or manipulate trait (as they offer up a token in their hands). They must pay tribute at least once on each of their turns, if possible. While affected, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you and can't use hostile actions against you.

Failure As success, but the target must pay tribute a total of six times.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target must spend all its actions paying tribute, and they cannot take other actions until the tribute is fully paid.

spell->Phantasmagoria.name: Phantasmagoria
spell->Phantasmagoria.description:
You fill the targets' minds with endless images, like countless dreams and lives colliding with each other. The onrushing information deals @Damage[16d6[mental]] damage to each target, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is confused for 1 minute.

spell->Telepathic Demand.name: Telepathic Demand
spell->Telepathic Demand.description: You send the target a message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer. Your message is insidious and has the effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} spell, with the message substituting for the spoken suggestion. On a successful save, the target is temporarily immune for 1 day, and on a critical success, the target is temporarily immune for 1 month. You can target a creature only if you've previously been in telepathic contact with it before, such as via the telepathy spell.

spell->Spirit Song.name: Spirit Song
spell->Spirit Song.description:
Your eldritch song sends pulsing waves of ethereal energy to attack creatures' spirits in the area, dealing 14d6 spirit damage that causes their bodies to momentarily freeze up from the hypnotic nature of the tune, depending on the result of their Fortitude save. The vibrating waves of spirit song penetrate into, but not through, solid barriers, damaging incorporeal creatures hiding in solid objects in the area but not passing onward to damage creatures in other rooms.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage and can't use reactions until the beginning of its turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, can't use reactions until the beginning of its turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, can't use reactions until the beginning of its turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Duplicate Foe.name: Duplicate Foe
spell->Duplicate Foe.description:
You create a temporary duplicate of an enemy to fight on your behalf. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to disrupt the spell. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and has the target's attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 70 Hit Points and lacks the target's special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except weapon potency runes.

The duplicate gains the minion trait, and it can only Stride and Strike. Its Strikes deal the target's normal damage but don't apply added effects, since it doesn't have special abilities. The spell automatically ends if the duplicate's Hit Points drop to 0.

The duplicate attacks your enemies to the best of its abilities. You can also try to give it additional instructions; when you Sustain the spell, you can also Command a Minion as part of your action, but the GM determines whether the duplicate follows your command.

The duplicate is unstable, so each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 4d6 Hit Points. It's not a living creature, and it can never regain its lost Hit Points in any way.

Critical Success You fail to create a duplicate.

Success The duplicate deals half damage with its Strikes and the duration is reduced to a maximum of 2 rounds.

Failure The duplicate works as described.

Heightened (+1) The level of creature you can target increases by 2. The duplicate has 10 more HP.

spell->Duplicate Foe.name: Duplicate Foe
spell->Duplicate Foe.description:
You create a temporary duplicate of an enemy to fight on your behalf. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to disrupt the spell. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and has the target's attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 70 Hit Points and lacks the target's special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except weapon potency runes.

The duplicate gains the minion trait, and it can only Stride and Strike. Its Strikes deal the target's normal damage but don't apply added effects, since it doesn't have special abilities. The spell automatically ends if the duplicate's Hit Points drop to 0.

The duplicate attacks your enemies to the best of its abilities. You can also try to give it additional instructions; when you Sustain the spell, you can also Command a Minion as part of your action, but the GM determines whether the duplicate follows your command.

The duplicate is unstable, so each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 4d6 Hit Points. It's not a living creature, and it can never regain its lost Hit Points in any way.

Critical Success You fail to create a duplicate.

Success The duplicate deals half damage with its Strikes and the duration is reduced to a maximum of 2 rounds.

Failure The duplicate works as described.

Heightened (+1) The level of creature you can target increases by 2. The duplicate has 10 more HP.

spell->Duplicate Foe.name: Duplicate Foe
spell->Duplicate Foe.description:
You create a temporary duplicate of an enemy to fight on your behalf. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to disrupt the spell. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and has the target's attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 70 Hit Points and lacks the target's special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except weapon potency runes.

The duplicate gains the minion trait, and it can only Stride and Strike. Its Strikes deal the target's normal damage but don't apply added effects, since it doesn't have special abilities. The spell automatically ends if the duplicate's Hit Points drop to 0.

The duplicate attacks your enemies to the best of its abilities. You can also try to give it additional instructions; when you Sustain the spell, you can also Command a Minion as part of your action, but the GM determines whether the duplicate follows your command.

The duplicate is unstable, so each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 4d6 Hit Points. It's not a living creature, and it can never regain its lost Hit Points in any way.

Critical Success You fail to create a duplicate.

Success The duplicate deals half damage with its Strikes and the duration is reduced to a maximum of 2 rounds.

Failure The duplicate works as described.

Heightened (+1) The level of creature you can target increases by 2. The duplicate has 10 more HP.

spell->Interplanar Teleport (First World.name: Interplanar Teleport (First World or the Universe only)
spell->Interplanar Teleport (First World.description:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

spell->Truesight (Constant).name: Truesight (Constant)
spell->Truesight (Constant).description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spell->Truespeech (Constant).name: Truespeech (Constant)
spell->Truespeech (Constant).description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Suggestion.name: Suggestion
spell->Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: Illusory Disguise (At Will)
spell->Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

spell->Read Aura.name: Read Aura
spell->Read Aura.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

spell->Telekinetic Projectile.name: Telekinetic Projectile
spell->Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->Duplicate Victim.name: Duplicate Victim
action->Duplicate Victim.description:
Trigger The risen fetch critically hits a humanoid target with a fetch weapon Strike and has a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.73rToy0v5Ra9NvL6]{Duplicate Foe} spell available

Effect The risen fetch casts duplicate foe on the target, who takes a –4 status penalty on the saving throw to resist.

action->Manifest Fetch Weapon.name: Manifest Fetch Weapon
action->Manifest Fetch Weapon.description:
Trigger The fetch starts their turn

Effect A fetch weapon manifests in the fetch's hand. As soon as a fetch weapon is no longer wielded by a fetch, it vanishes. The fetch chooses the type of weapon they manifest, but it does not gain any of that weapon's standard weapon traits, damage die, or damage type, instead using the traits and statistics listed above in the fetch weapon Strike.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Steady Spellcasting
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: If a reaction would disrupt the risen fetch's spellcasting action, the risen fetch attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

Sangoi.name: Sangoi
Sangoi.publicNotes: With their nocturnal habits, taste for blood, and proclivity for haunting towns and graveyards in the dead of night, it's unsurprising that sangois are often mistaken for vampires. These smaller fey hunt by following the sounds of their victims' hearts, preferring humanoid victims but settling for animal blood if necessary. They wear roughly cut animal hides to stay warm and are often mistaken for prowling coyotes or wildcats when glimpsed from a window on a cold, misty night.

spell->Invisibility (Self Only).name: Invisibility (Self Only)
spell->Invisibility (Self Only).description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Speak with Animals (Constant).name: Speak with Animals (Constant)
spell->Speak with Animals (Constant).description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

spell->Command (Animals Only).name: Command (Animals Only)
spell->Command (Animals Only).description:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Daze.name: Daze
spell->Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

action->Sunlight Transparency.name: Sunlight Transparency
action->Sunlight Transparency.description: Sunlight causes the sangoi to partially fade from view, growing feeble and translucent. While exposed to direct sunlight, the sangoi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

action->Blood Rage.name: Blood Rage
action->Blood Rage.description:
Trigger The sangoi is reduced below 45 Hit Points by an enemy

Effect The sangoi flies into a rage. They gain 20 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to melee attack rolls but take a –2 penalty to their AC. These effects last for 1 minute or until the sangoi goes a full round without dealing or taking damage, whichever comes first. The sangoi can't end their rage voluntarily.

action->Bloodsense.name: Bloodsense
action->Bloodsense.description: The sangoi can hear the beating hearts and smell the rushing blood of all living creatures as an imprecise sense within the listed range. They can detect creatures taking persistent bleed damage as a precise sense.

action->Curse of Misery.name: Curse of Misery
action->Curse of Misery.description: A creature hit by a sangoi's claws Strike must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:22] save or become cursed for 1 minute. This curse imparts a –1 status penalty to a victim's AC and saving throws against the sangoi who cursed them. In addition, when a cursed victim attempts the flat check to recover from any persistent bleed damage, they must roll twice and take the worse result; this is a misfortune effect.

action->Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
action->Sneak Attack.description: The sangoi deals an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

action->Vicious Draught.name: Vicious Draught
action->Vicious Draught.description:
Requirements A creature within the sangoi's reach is taking persistent bleed damage

Effect The sangoi latches onto the creature's open wound, drinking their blood. They attempt a jaws Strike against the target; if the target is willing, the Strike automatically hits. If the Strike hits, the persistent bleed condition ends, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, and the sangoi regains Hit Points equal to the target's level, gaining any excess HP as temporary HP. Taking a Vicious Draught from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the sangoi but increases the victim's drained value by 1 (to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}).

If the sangoi is in a Blood Rage and the jaws Strike reduces the target to 0 HP, the victim must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. On a failure, the sangoi tears out the target's heart and devours it, killing it instantly. This is a death effect.

Sard.name: Sard
Sard.publicNotes: An immense, gnarled tree awoken with raw, primal power by one of the Eldest of the First World, this legendary Tane skitters on huge, spidery roots and thrashes their branches. Fiery lightning courses within their blackened bark, a living manifestation of the violent clash between ancient forest and stormy sky. Sards are created as living siege engines, awoken by the Eldest when the target of their ire tries to hide behind stone walls and high battlements. The blood-red lightning that runs through a sard's twisted trunk instead of sap makes short work of such mortal defenses, great arcs of electricity tearing through stone and those that hide behind it. As representations of the cataclysmic destruction of serene beauty, sards take cruel glee in their work.
Sard.saveDetails: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

spell->Wrathful Storm.name: Wrathful Storm
spell->Wrathful Storm.description:
A massive storm cloud forms in the air above the area, spreading rain and gales. The wind imposes a –4 circumstance penalty to physical ranged attacks. The air in the area is greater difficult terrain for flying creatures. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain it on subsequent rounds, you can choose one of the following storm effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.

  • Blizzard The driving snow deals @Damage[4d8[cold]] damage to each creature in or below the storm with no save. Everything in or beneath the cloud is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} by driving snow and any ground is difficult terrain.
  • Hail Each creature in or below the storm takes @Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]] damage with a basic Fortitude save.
  • Lightning Choose up to 10 creatures in or below the storm to be struck by lightning. Each of them takes @Damage[7d6[electricity]] damage with a basic Reflex save.
  • Tornado A roughly cylindrical whirlwind appears in or below the cloud in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in the whirlwind is thrown 40 feet upward.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.SjxqjPDILhQWUcWf]{Spell Effect: Wrathful Storm}

Heightened (10th) The range increases to 2,000 feet and the cloud is a 1,000-foot burst.

spell->Control Weather (Doesn't require.name: Control Weather (Doesn't require secondary casters)
spell->Control Weather (Doesn't require.description:
Area 2-mile-radius circle centered on you

You alter the weather, making it calm and normal for the season or choosing up to two effects based on the season.

  • Spring drizzle, heat, hurricane, sleet, thunderstorm, tornado
  • Summer drizzle, downpour, extreme heat, hail, heat
  • Autumn cold weather, fog, mild heat, sleet
  • Winter blizzard, mild cold, extreme cold, thaw

You can't specifically control the manifestations, such as the exact path of a tornado or the targets of lightning strikes.

Critical Success You change the weather as desired and can affect a larger area (up to a 5-mile-radius circle), or a longer duration (any number of additional d12 hours, up to 16d12).

Success You change the weather as desired.

Failure You fail to change the weather as desired.

Critical Failure The weather changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, a terrible storm emerges when you would prefer good weather).

Heightened (9th) You can create unseasonable weather and contradictory weather effects, such as extreme cold and a hurricane. You can make the weather calm and normal weather for a different season or choose weather effects from any season's list.

spell->Punishing Winds.name: Punishing Winds
spell->Punishing Winds.description:
Area (continued) 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-tall cylinder

Violent winds and a powerful downdraft fill the area, forming a cyclone. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground or Climbing. Any creature that ends its turn Flying within the area descends 20 feet. Any creature pushed into a surface by this spell's winds takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

The squares at the outside vertical edges of the cylinder prevent creatures from leaving. These squares are greater difficult terrain, and a creature attempting to push through must succeed at an Athletics check or Acrobatics check to Maneuver in Flight against your spell DC to get through. A creature that fails ends its current action but can try again.

spell->Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
spell->Chain Lightning.description:
You discharge a powerful bolt of lightning at the target, dealing 8d12 electricity damage. The target must attempt a basic Reflex save. The electricity arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the chain at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome). The chain ends if any one of the targets critically succeeds at its save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
spell->Chain Lightning.target: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures

spell->Nature's Pathway.name: Nature's Pathway
spell->Nature's Pathway.description:
You step into a living tree with a trunk big enough for you to fit inside it and instantly teleport to any tree within 5 miles that also has a sufficiently large trunk. Once you enter the first tree, you instantly know the rough locations of other sufficiently large trees within range and can exit from the original tree, if you prefer. You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you; if you attempt to do so, the spell fails.

Heightened (6th) The tree you exit can be up to 50 miles away.

Heightened (8th) The tree you exit can be up to 500 miles away.

Heightened (9th) The tree you exit can be anywhere on the same planet.

action->Planar Acclimation.name: Planar Acclimation
action->Planar Acclimation.description: The sard treats the plane it is located on as its home plane.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->Splintering Death.name: Splintering Death
action->Splintering Death.description: When the sard dies, its body explodes in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. All creatures in the area take @Damage[10d6[electricity],10d6[piercing]|options:area-damage]{10d6 electricity damage and 10d6 piercing damage} (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic|options:area-effect] save). Any creature that takes piercing damage is also exposed to sard venom.

action->Lightning-Struck Curse.name: Lightning-Struck Curse
action->Lightning-Struck Curse.description:
Trigger The sard is about to damage a creature that has electricity resistance

Effect An instant before the target takes the electricity damage from the triggering event, the sard's electrical sparks glow red. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:41] save or lose any electricity resistance it has until this curse is lifted.

action->Sard Venom.name: Sard Venom
action->Sard Venom.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:41]

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[electricity],2d6[poison]] damage, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[electricity],3d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[4d6[electricity],4d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 round)

action->Thorn Volley.name: Thorn Volley
action->Thorn Volley.description: The sard makes up to four thorn Strikes, each against a different target. The sard's multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks have been made.

Seilenos.name: Seilenos
Seilenos.publicNotes:
Old and well-traveled, a seilenos has seen many things in their existence. They remember when the First World was the only world. They've seen empires come and go, godlings rise and fall. With the legs, ears, and tail of a horse, gnarled beard, and skin as weathered as old oak, many mortals mistake depictions of seilenoi for arboreals or green men.

A seilenos might act as mercurial judge, fun-loving master of ceremonies, or ruthless bandit leader. Never-before-seen spectacles of beauty, music, and art compel a seilenos's attention, and they have ways of inspiring those they meet to follow their creative pursuits to the extreme. Most seilenoi view the idea of combat as amusing, but should they become roused to anger, their power is terrifying.

spell->Unfathomable Song.name: Unfathomable Song
spell->Unfathomable Song.description:
Fleeting notes of a strange and unnatural song fill the air, overtaking the mind. Each target must attempt a Will save when you cast the spell, and again the first time you Sustain this Spell each round. A creature needs to attempt only one save against the song each round, and you have to keep the same targets when you Sustain the Spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, can't be affected on subsequent rounds, and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected this round, but it can be affected on subsequent rounds.

Failure Roll [[/r 1d4]] on the table below.

Critical Failure Roll [[/r 1d4+1]] on the table below.

Result Effect
1 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}
2 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round
3 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} for 1 round
4 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round
5 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for an unlimited duration

spell->Uncontrollable Dance.name: Uncontrollable Dance
spell->Uncontrollable Dance.description:
The target is overcome with an all-consuming urge to dance. For the duration of the spell, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and can't use reactions. While affected, the creature can't use move actions except to dance, using the Stride action to move up to half its Speed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The spell's duration is 3 rounds, and the target must spend at least 1 action each turn dancing.

Failure The spell's duration is 1 minute, and the target must spend at least 2 actions each turn dancing.

Critical Failure The spell's duration is 1 minute, and the target must spend all its actions each turn dancing.

spell->Warp Mind.name: Warp Mind
spell->Warp Mind.description:
You scramble a creature's mental faculties and sensory input. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result of that save, the target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes. Warp mind's effects happen instantly, so @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} and other effects that counteract spells can't counteract them. However, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} rituals and abilities that can remove non-magical effects can still counteract the effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target spends the first action on its next turn with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Confused permanently.

spell->Illusory Scene (At Will).name: Illusory Scene (At Will)
spell->Illusory Scene (At Will).description:
You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

spell->Truespeech (Constant).name: Truespeech (Constant)
spell->Truespeech (Constant).description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Curse of Verse.name: Curse of Verse
spell->Curse of Verse.description:
You curse the target to speak in rhyme, disrupting its ability to communicate normally or cast spells. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, whenever the target uses an action with the linguistic trait or Casts a Spell, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or the action is disrupted. However, the target also gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Performance checks to sing, perform poetry, or do any other task that would benefit from the ability to rhyme effortlessly (at the GM's discretion). The target automatically succeeds at the flat check to attempt actions with the linguistic trait that include such a check and can attempt them even if the target is untrained in Performance and the action normally requires it to be trained.

Failure As success, but the flat check DC is 8 and the duration is 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect is permanent.

spell->Suggestion.name: Suggestion
spell->Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Heroism (Other Creatures only).name: Heroism  (Other Creatures only)
spell->Heroism (Other Creatures only).description:
You unlock the target's inner heroism, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (9th) The status bonus increases to +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}

spell->Laughing Fit.name: Laughing Fit
spell->Laughing Fit.description:
The target is overtaken with uncontrollable laughter. It must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can't use reactions.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and can't use actions or reactions for 1 round. It then takes the effects of a failure.

spell->Paranoia.name: Paranoia
spell->Paranoia.description:
You cause the target to see all other creatures as dire threats. The target is stricken by intense paranoia toward all creatures around it and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally. The spell ends after 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

spell->Charm.name: Charm
spell->Charm.description:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Fear.name: Fear
spell->Fear.description:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

spell->Figment.name: Figment
spell->Figment.description:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

spell->Haunting Hymn.name: Haunting Hymn
spell->Haunting Hymn.description:
You echo a jarring hymn that only creatures in the area can hear. The hymn deals 1d8 sonic damage, with a basic Fortitude save. If a target critically fails the save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell->Light.name: Light
spell->Light.description:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

spell->Sleep.name: Sleep
spell->Sleep.description:
Each creature in the area becomes drowsy, possibly nodding off. A creature that falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} from this spell doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or release what it's holding. This spell doesn't prevent creatures from waking up due to a successful Perception check, limiting its utility in combat.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

Heightened (4th) The creatures fall unconscious for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure. They fall prone and release what they're holding, and they can't attempt Perception checks to wake up. When the duration ends, the creature is sleeping normally instead of automatically waking up.

spell->Summon Instrument.name: Summon Instrument
spell->Summon Instrument.description:
You materialize a handheld musical instrument in your grasp. The instrument is typical for its type, but it plays only for you. It vanishes when the spell ends. If you cast summon instrument again, any instrument you previously summoned disappears.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.oarBuzYXLl10pcO9]{Spell Effect: Summon Instrument}
