Sprilbrahn.name: Sprilbrahn
Sprilbrahn.languages: Speak with animals, Speak with plants
Sprilbrahn.publicNotes: Sprilbrahns serve as the guardians of the First World, facing anyone that seeks to corrupt the plane and sometimes serving as commanders against such foes for the armies of the Eldest. Occasionally, they also travel into the mortal Universe to fight against magical and mundane corruptions that threaten natural areas and could potentially seep into the First World. A sprilbrahn is an awesome sight in combat: a stoic and determined humanoid warrior clad in armor made from hardened flower petals, bearing a mighty scythe and borne aloft in turn by wings made of flower petals.

spell->Desiccate.name: Desiccate
spell->Desiccate.description:
You pull the moisture from the targets' bodies, dealing 10d10 void damage. Creatures made of water (such as water elementals) and plant creatures use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their saving throw. Creatures whose bodies contain no significant moisture (such as earth elementals) are immune to desiccate.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

spell->Migration.name: Migration
spell->Migration.description:
The targets naturally take on animal forms most fitting their movement and environment. Each target gains a land, burrow, climb, fly, and swim Speed of 40 feet, and can transform into a Tiny or Small animal most appropriate for a given movement and environment. It also gains immunity to mild, severe, and extreme cold and heat, along with any other immunities common to the local wildlife, at the GM's discretion. In exploration mode, a target can move much faster, at a travel Speed of 20 miles per hour.

A target can't Strike, cast spells, or use most manipulate actions in animal form, but it can resume its normal shape by Sustaining the spell. It can Sustain the spell again to resume animal form.
spell->Migration.target: you and up to 5 willing creatures

spell->Interplanar Teleport (At-Will, Se.name: Interplanar Teleport (At-Will, Self Only)
spell->Interplanar Teleport (At-Will, Se.description:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

spell->Tangling Creepers.name: Tangling Creepers
spell->Tangling Creepers.description:
Dense, twitching creepers sprout from every surface and fill any bodies of water in the area. Any creature moving on the land, or Climbing or Swimming within the creepers, takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds while in the area. Once per round, you can Sustain the spell to make a vine lash out from any square within the expanse of creepers. This vine has a 15-foot reach. Make a melee spell attack roll against the target; on a success, the vine pulls the target into the creepers and makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes} (against your spell DC), whichever comes first.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5RiskDnSXaRI6F4n]{Spell Effect: Tangling Creepers}

spell->Nature's Pathway.name: Nature's Pathway
spell->Nature's Pathway.description:
You step into a living tree with a trunk big enough for you to fit inside it and instantly teleport to any tree within 5 miles that also has a sufficiently large trunk. Once you enter the first tree, you instantly know the rough locations of other sufficiently large trees within range and can exit from the original tree, if you prefer. You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you; if you attempt to do so, the spell fails.

Heightened (6th) The tree you exit can be up to 50 miles away.

Heightened (8th) The tree you exit can be up to 500 miles away.

Heightened (9th) The tree you exit can be anywhere on the same planet.

spell->Speak with Plants (Constant).name: Speak with Plants (Constant)
spell->Speak with Plants (Constant).description:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Wall of Thorns.name: Wall of Thorns
spell->Wall of Thorns.description:
You grow a wall of thorny brambles from the ground. You create a 5-foot-thick wall of brambles and thorns in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically. If you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall has cover from creatures on the opposite side, and the wall's spaces are difficult terrain. For every move action a creature uses to enter at least one of the wall's spaces, that creature takes 3d4 piercing damage.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points. It's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section can be moved through freely.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 5, and the piercing damage increases by 1d4.

spell->Speak with Animals (Constant).name: Speak with Animals (Constant)
spell->Speak with Animals (Constant).description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

spell->Caustic Blast.name: Caustic Blast
spell->Caustic Blast.description:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.

spell->Guidance.name: Guidance
spell->Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

spell->Ignition.name: Ignition
spell->Ignition.description:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}

spell->Tangle Vine.name: Tangle Vine
spell->Tangle Vine.description:
A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

action->Feywrath Blade.name: Feywrath Blade
action->Feywrath Blade.description: A sprilbrahn wields a powerful scythe known as a feywrath blade. In the sprilbrahn's hands only, this weapon functions as a +3 major striking vorpal scythe with the reach trait. The sprilbrahn can recall the blade to their hand at any time by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait. If the weapon is destroyed, the sprilbrahn can spend 1 hour during their daily preparations to plant a single seed and regrow their personal feywrath blade. When a sprilbrahn dies, their feywrath blade immediately crumbles into petals and is destroyed.

action->Petalsight.name: Petalsight
action->Petalsight.description: A sprilbrahn can see through any flower within 10 miles. They can use a single action, which has the the concentrate trait, to either shift their vision to a flower within range or return it to their body. While perceiving in this way, the sprilbrahn's body is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, but they can use their other senses as normal.

action->Fey Reflexes.name: Fey Reflexes
action->Fey Reflexes.description: The sprilbrahn gains an additional reaction at the beginning of each of their turns that they can use only for a Reactive Strike.

action->Curse of the Bloom.name: Curse of the Bloom
action->Curse of the Bloom.description: The sprilbrahn implants a seed of pure First World energy into any number of creatures within 30 feet. The seed instantly grows, causing a mass of flowers to bloom out from beneath the creatures' skin, dealing @Damage[20d6[piercing]] damage (basic @Check[fortitude|dc:39] save). A creature who takes any damage is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute, after which the flowers wilt away. Regardless of the result of its save, a creature becomes temporarily immune to all other Curses of the Bloom for 24 hours.

action->Reap the Treacherous.name: Reap the Treacherous
action->Reap the Treacherous.description: The sprilbrahn Flies up to its fly Speed and makes two feywrath blade Strikes at any point during that movement. Each Strike must target a different creature. The attacks take the normal multiple attack penalty.

Spring-Heeled Jack.name: Spring-Heeled Jack
Spring-Heeled Jack.publicNotes:
The greatest secret of the murderous trickster known as Spring-Heeled Jack is that he isn't a unique creature. Instead, he's one of a rare type of fey native to the First World who enjoy causing bloody mayhem in the Universe. These fey are so rare (and so distrustful of each other's company) that two have never been seen together; the mistaken assumption that only a single spring-heeled jack exists is therefore entirely understandable. The fact that sightings occur across Ustalav (and beyond), across centuries of time, is ascribed to the trickster's long lifespan and mysterious ability to travel quickly, or to the belief that there's no such creature, merely an urban legend that twisted minds attempt to bring to life through costumes, magic, and a series of murders and mayhem. Even in fear-drenched Ustalav, no one has yet guessed that multiple spring-heeled jacks exist.

Spring-heeled jacks are cruel-eyed, hairy fey with vaguely humanoid shapes and extra features that cause them to be easily mistaken for demons or devils. Glowing eyes, cloven hooves, menacing horns, and a pointed tail combine to create the mien of a wicked imp; their love of sudden and sadistic violence completes the impression. Almost all have jet-black skin and fur, though a few exceptions might exist.

In the nighttime conditions they enjoy, spring-heeled jacks typically hide their features in tattered cloaks, appearing as a hunched elder or a youth. Such a disguise rarely holds up to any scrutiny, but that doesn't matter much to the spring-heeled jack, who only needs something that offers just enough doubt for their target to move within striking distance—which can be much greater than most creatures realize. Once close enough, the spring-heeled jack leaps startling distances in the flicker of an eye to easily slash at a victim who had, until that moment, considered themself safe.

0.label: to High Jump or Long Jump

spell->Magic Passage.name: Magic Passage
spell->Magic Passage.description:
You create a visible tunnel through the wall in the chosen area, replacing the area with empty space. If the wall is thicker than 10 feet, the tunnel ends 10 feet in. Even a small layer of metal in the wall prevents this spell from functioning. This spell doesn't reduce the integrity of the structure. When the spell ends, anyone inside the tunnel is shunted to the nearest exit.

Heightened (7th) The tunnel can be up to 20 feet deep. The areas of the wall that contain your tunnel's entrance appear completely normal (unless viewed with truesight or a similar effect), despite the tunnel's existence. The tunnel's entrance functions as a solid wall, but you can specify a password or a trigger, allowing creatures to enter freely.

spell->Gentle Landing (At Will).name: Gentle Landing (At Will)
spell->Gentle Landing (At Will).description:
Trigger a creature within range is falling

You raise a magical updraft to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

spell->Vanishing Tracks (Constant).name: Vanishing Tracks (Constant)
spell->Vanishing Tracks (Constant).description:
You obscure the tracks you leave behind. The DC of checks to Track you gains a +4 status bonus or is equal to your spell DC, whichever results in a higher DC.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 8 hours. The spell has a range of 20 feet and targets up to 10 creatures.

weapon->Little Love.description:
tag will get replaced with text from compendium entry @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.RgVOC3rpptrwENbu]

This steel +1 dagger is chipped and worn but no less deadly for its much-used appearance. When you critically succeed at an attack roll with Little Love, you can activate the dagger to spring away from your foes.

Activate f Interact

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You critically hit a creature with Little Love

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} (or Vault, if you're Spring-Heeled Jack).

0.text: f Interact; Frequency once per 10 minutes; Effect You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} (or Vault, if you're Spring-Heeled Jack).

equipment->Jack's Tattered Cape.description:
tag will get replaced with text from compendium entry @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.QOAjwtH9gycbDZCY]

This ragged, mud-stained cape closes with a single black button engraved with a leering devil's face. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} (or Vault, if you're Spring-Heeled Jack), you gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} until the start of your next turn.

action->Exhale Flame.name: Exhale Flame
action->Exhale Flame.description: The spring-heeled jack exhales a gout of bright blue fire that deals @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save). They can't use Exhale Flame again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Exhale Flame]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Leap Away.name: Leap Away
action->Leap Away.description:
Trigger The spring-heeled jack critically hits a creature with their dagger

Effect The spring-heeled jack Vaults.

action->Malicious Stab.name: Malicious Stab
action->Malicious Stab.description: Spring-Heeled Jack deals an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} creatures (2d6 precision damage to creatures that are both off-guard and frightened).

action->Vault.name: Vault
action->Vault.description: Spring-Heeled Jack jumps up to 20 feet in any direction, including vertically. This movement doesn't trigger reactions based on movement.

Sprite Swarm.name: Sprite Swarm
Sprite Swarm.publicNotes:
Individually and upon first impression, many sprites seem to be cute and harmless. However, should they get angry or feel the need to act en masse, they gather together into a dangerous swarm. Wielding needles or simply brandishing sharp teeth or claws, a swarm of sprites can catch the unwary by fatal surprise.

Elusive, flighty, and ebullient, sprites are what many villagers first imagine when they hear the terms "fey" or "fairy."

action->Glaring Glow.name: Glaring Glow
action->Glaring Glow.description: Many of the sprites in the swarm glow with a painful intensity. All other creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (including those in the sprite's space) must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

action->Spark Bombardment.name: Spark Bombardment
action->Spark Bombardment.description: In unison, several sprites hurl tiny, hot sparks at a creature within 20 feet, dealing @Damage[5d4[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

action->Spritely Steal.name: Spritely Steal
action->Spritely Steal.description: The sprites rummage through the possessions of a single creature within their space, attempting a @Check[thievery|against:reflex] check against the creature's Reflex DC. On a success, the sprites take one item of negligible or light Bulk that the creature is carrying but not holding, nor can the item be readied. On a critical success, the item can be one that is held or readied, such as a weapon or potion.

action->Swarming Needles.name: Swarming Needles
action->Swarming Needles.description: The sprites swing tiny rapiers and other pointy weapons to deal @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage to each enemy in the swarm's space (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

Summer Hora.name: Summer Hora
Summer Hora.languages: Speak with animals, Speak with plants
Summer Hora.publicNotes:
While most nymphs bond with a natural feature, such as a tree, pool, or cave, horai are rare nymphs associated with a specific time—solstices and equinoxes—rather than a location. Horai erect simple astronomical calendars near their homes, which they use to mark the moment when the sun reaches its highest or lowest point in the sky. A hora tied to the summer solstice grows more powerful as the sun reaches its height, while becoming sickly and weak during the winter solstice. The opposite holds true for winter horai, who are weak in summer and strong in winter. Meanwhile, autumn and spring horai draw power near the autumnal and vernal equinoxes, respectively, becoming weaker around the opposite equinox.

Summer horai appear constantly bathed in sunlight, with skin and clothing of red, orange, and yellow, like the sunlight of high summer.

Winter, Spring and Autumn Horai

The statistics here are for summer horai, but you can represent the other three types of horai with minor alterations.

Winter horai have resistance to cold rather than fire, and their strikes deal cold damage instead of fire; are winter bound (impeded during summer months); and have Winter's Rescue (+4 during the month of the winter solstice, +2 on the months just before and after, +1 in spring and autumn, and no benefit during the summer). For a winter hora queen, being tied to the land improves the environment in winter and twists it in summer.

Autumn horai have resistance to void instead of fire, and their strikes deal void damage instead of fire; are autumn bound (impeded during spring); and have Autumn's Rescue (+4 during the month of the autumnal equinox, +2 on the months just before and after, +1 in summer and winter, and no benefit during spring). For an autumn hora queen, tied to the land improves the environment in autumn and twists it in spring.

Spring horai have no resistance, and their strikes deal vitality damage instead of fire (harming only creatures with void healing, as normal); are spring bound (impeded during autumn); and have Spring's Rescue (+4 during the month of the vernal equinox, +2 on the months just before and after, +1 in winter and summer, and no benefit during autumn). For a spring hora queen, tied to the land improves the environment in spring and twists it in autumn.

spell->Animal Vision.name: Animal Vision
spell->Animal Vision.description: You tap into the target's senses, allowing you to sense whatever it senses for the spell's duration. If the target wishes to prevent you from doing so, it can attempt a Will save, negating the spell on a success, but most animals don't bother to do so. While tapping into the target's senses, you can't use your own body's senses, but you can change back and forth from your body's senses to the target's senses using a Sustain action.

spell->Curse of Lost Time.name: Curse of Lost Time
spell->Curse of Lost Time.description:
You curse the target with rapid aging or erosion. The effect depends on whether the target is an object, a construct, or a living creature. Artifacts, along with objects and constructs made of precious materials (as determined by the GM), are immune.

  • Object If the object is attended, its bearer can attempt a Fortitude save. If the bearer fails or the object is unattended, the object immediately takes 4d6 damage (applying Hardness normally) and the item is cursed with an unlimited duration. Until the curse ends, the item becomes shoddy and can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repaired}, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the object's Hit Points. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} can target an item affected by this spell.
  • Construct The construct takes 4d6 damage (basic Fortitude save). On a failure, for 1 hour the construct is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, and can't be Repaired, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the construct's Hit Points. On a critical failure, these effects have an unlimited duration.
  • Living Creature The living creature must attempt a Fortitude save. Ageless creatures are immune.
    • Critical Success The living creature is unaffected.
    • Success The living creature briefly ages, becoming clumsy 1 and enfeebled 1 for 1 round.
    • Failure As success, with a duration of 1 hour.
    • Critical Failure As success, with an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
spell->Curse of Lost Time.target: 1 Large or smaller object, construct, or living creature

spell->Animal Messenger.name: Animal Messenger
spell->Animal Messenger.description:
You offer food, and an ordinary Tiny animal within range approaches to eat it. You imprint the image, direction, and distance of an obvious place or landmark well known to you within the animal. You can also attach a small object or note up to light Bulk to it. The animal does its best to reach the destination; if it makes it there, it waits nearby and allows nonhostile creatures to approach and remove the attached object. The spell ends after the message is delivered or after 24 hours, whichever comes first.

If there are no Tiny wild animals in range, the spell is lost.

spell->Revealing Light.name: Revealing Light
spell->Revealing Light.description:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

spell->Alarm.name: Alarm
spell->Alarm.description:
You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the mental trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the auditory trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:15] check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a Stealth check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

Heightened (3rd) You can specify a trigger for which types of creatures sound the alarm spell.

spell->Know the Way.name: Know the Way
spell->Know the Way.description:
In your mind's eye, you magically reorient yourself. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location), and you can choose a location you were at within the last 24 hours and learn what direction it lies.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose a location you were at within the last week.

Heightened (7th) You can choose a location you were at regardless of how long ago you were there.

spell->Light.name: Light
spell->Light.description:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

spell->Vanishing Tracks (At Will).name: Vanishing Tracks (At Will)
spell->Vanishing Tracks (At Will).description:
You obscure the tracks you leave behind. The DC of checks to Track you gains a +4 status bonus or is equal to your spell DC, whichever results in a higher DC.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 8 hours. The spell has a range of 20 feet and targets up to 10 creatures.

action->Summer Bound.name: Summer Bound
action->Summer Bound.description: During the winter months, a summer hora can't take reactions, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and can't reduce their sickened condition below 1.

action->Solstice Dependent.name: Solstice Dependent
action->Solstice Dependent.description: A hora is mystically bonded to a natural location with a simple astronomical calendar that marks the summer and winter solstice. If they aren't at that location at dawn when the sunlight touches the calendar, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, increasing the value by 1 for each missed day and reducing by 1 only when they witness dawn's light touch the calendar. Even on a cloudy day, there's enough sunlight to satisfy the hora's need. A hora can perform a 24-hour ritual to bond to a new location.

action->Summer's Rescue.name: Summer's Rescue
action->Summer's Rescue.description:
Trigger The summer hora or an ally within 30 feet that the summer hora can see fails a Perception check or saving throw

Effect The hora's or ally's check gains a retroactive status bonus, which can change the outcome from a critical failure to a failure or a failure to a success. This bonus is +2 in summer, increasing to +4 if it's within 14 days of the summer solstice. In spring or autumn, the bonus is +1, and in winter this ability has no effect. The summer hora can't use Summer's Rescue again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Summer's Rescue]]{1d4 rounds}.

Summer Hora Queen.name: Summer Hora Queen
Summer Hora Queen.languages: Speak with animals, Speak with plants
Summer Hora Queen.publicNotes:
Hora queens rule over wide stretches of land, nourishing and protecting native animals and plants. Most hora queens watch over their regions in pairs: one summer and one winter, or one autumn and one spring.

Winter, Spring and Autumn Horai

The statistics here are for summer horai, but you can represent the other three types of horai with minor alterations.

Winter horai have resistance to cold rather than fire, and their strikes deal cold damage instead of fire; are winter bound (impeded during summer months); and have Winter's Rescue (+4 during the month of the winter solstice, +2 on the months just before and after, +1 in spring and autumn, and no benefit during the summer). For a winter hora queen, being tied to the land improves the environment in winter and twists it in summer.

Autumn horai have resistance to void instead of fire, and their strikes deal void damage instead of fire; are autumn bound (impeded during spring); and have Autumn's Rescue (+4 during the month of the autumnal equinox, +2 on the months just before and after, +1 in summer and winter, and no benefit during spring). For an autumn hora queen, tied to the land improves the environment in autumn and twists it in spring.

Spring horai have no resistance, and their strikes deal vitality damage instead of fire (harming only creatures with void healing, as normal); are spring bound (impeded during autumn); and have Spring's Rescue (+4 during the month of the vernal equinox, +2 on the months just before and after, +1 in winter and summer, and no benefit during autumn). For a spring hora queen, tied to the land improves the environment in spring and twists it in autumn.

spell->Fiery Body.name: Fiery Body
spell->Fiery Body.description:
You become living flame, giving you fire immunity, resistance 10 to precision damage, and weakness 5 to cold and to water. Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage.

Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 fire damage, and your fire spells deal one additional die of fire damage (of the same damage die the spell uses). You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition} as an innate spell; the casting is reduced from 2 actions to 1.

In fire form, you have a fly Speed of 40 feet and don't need to breathe.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.uIMaMzd6pcKmMNPJ]{Spell Effect: Fiery Body}

Heightened (9th) Creatures touching you take @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage instead of 3d6, your unarmed attacks deal 2d4 additional fire damage, and you have a fly Speed of 60 feet.

spell->Regenerate.name: Regenerate
spell->Regenerate.description:
An infusion of vital energy grants a creature continuous healing. The target temporarily gains regeneration 15, which restores 15 Hit Points to it at the start of each of its turns. While it has regeneration, the target can't die from taking Hit Point damage and its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition can't increase to a value that would kill it (this stops most creatures' dying condition at dying 3), though if its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value becomes 4 or higher, it stays @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until its wounds are treated. If the target takes acid or fire damage, its regeneration deactivates until after the end of its next turn.

Each time the creature regains Hit Points from regeneration, it also regrows one damaged or ruined organ (if any). During the spell's duration, the creature can also reattach severed body parts by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.dXq7z633ve4E0nlX]{Spell Effect: Regenerate}

Heightened (9th) The regeneration increases to 20.

spell->Sunburst.name: Sunburst
spell->Sunburst.description:
A powerful globe of searing sunlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional @Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]] damage to undead creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} permanently.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical darkness, sunburst attempts to counteract the darkness effect.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.

spell->Blanket of Stars.name: Blanket of Stars
spell->Blanket of Stars.description:
A flowing cloak of utter darkness drapes over you, filled with pinpricks of light like distant stars. It imparts the stillness of the cosmos to you, granting you a +2 status bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.

While outside under a starry night sky, you're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} as long as you remain still. When moving under a starry night sky, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead.

Gazing too closely into the stars is disorienting. Any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you must attempt a Will save; this is a mental, visual effect.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} and dazzled until the end of its next turn.

spell->Cursed Metamorphosis.name: Cursed Metamorphosis
spell->Cursed Metamorphosis.description:
You transform the target creature into a harmless animal appropriate to the area, with effects based on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's body gains minor features of the harmless animal. Its insides churn as they partially transform, causing it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. When it recovers from the sickened condition, its features revert to normal.

Failure The target transforms for 1 minute but keeps its mind. If it spends all its actions on its turn concentrating on its original form, it can attempt a @Check[will] save to end the effect immediately.

Critical Failure The target is transformed into the chosen harmless animal, body and mind, for an unlimited duration.

spell->Truesight.name: Truesight
spell->Truesight.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spell->Banishment.name: Banishment
spell->Banishment.description:
You send the target back to its home plane. The target must attempt a Will save. You can spend an extra action while Casting this Spell and add a cost to the spell to give the creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save. The cost must be a specially gathered object that is anathema to the creature. This spell fails if you aren't on your home plane when you cast it.

Critical Success The target resists being banished and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target resists being banished.

Failure The target is banished.

Critical Failure The target is banished and can't return by any means to the plane it's banished from for 1 week.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to 10 creatures. The extra cost affects targets to which it is anathema.
spell->Banishment.target: 1 creature that isn't on its home plane

spell->Nature's Pathway.name: Nature's Pathway
spell->Nature's Pathway.description:
You step into a living tree with a trunk big enough for you to fit inside it and instantly teleport to any tree within 5 miles that also has a sufficiently large trunk. Once you enter the first tree, you instantly know the rough locations of other sufficiently large trees within range and can exit from the original tree, if you prefer. You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you; if you attempt to do so, the spell fails.

Heightened (6th) The tree you exit can be up to 50 miles away.

Heightened (8th) The tree you exit can be up to 500 miles away.

Heightened (9th) The tree you exit can be anywhere on the same planet.

spell->Speak with Stones.name: Speak with Stones
spell->Speak with Stones.description:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Fire Shield.name: Fire Shield
spell->Fire Shield.description:
You create a hovering shield made of fire. As long as the shield persists, its heat grants you cold resistance 5 and makes you immune to mild and severe environmental cold. You can Raise a Shield with the fire shield as a normal shield to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. You can use the Shield Block reaction with the fire shield, which has Hardness 10, is immune to fire, and has 40 HP (with no Broken Threshold), and its Hardness is halved against effects that have the water trait. If you Shield Block a melee attack that is either an unarmed attack or made by an adjacent attacker, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{Spell Effect: Fire Shield}

Heightened (+2) The cold resistance increases by 5, the HP increase by 10, and the fire damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Fly.name: Fly
spell->Fly.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

spell->Vital Beacon.name: Vital Beacon
spell->Vital Beacon.description:
Vitality radiates outward from you, allowing others to supplicate and receive healing. Once per round, either you or an ally can use an Interact action to supplicate and lay hands upon you to regain Hit Points. Each time the beacon heals someone, it decreases in strength. It restores @Damage[(@item.rank)d10[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the first creature, @Damage[(@item.rank)d8[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the second, @Damage[(@item.rank)d6[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the third, and @Damage[(@item.rank)d4[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the fourth, after which the spell ends. You can have only one vital beacon active at a time.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.WWtSEJGwKY4bQpUn]{Spell Effect: Vital Beacon}

Heightened (+1) The beacon restores one additional die of Hit Points each time it heals, using the same die size as the others for that step.

spell->Animal Vision.name: Animal Vision
spell->Animal Vision.description: You tap into the target's senses, allowing you to sense whatever it senses for the spell's duration. If the target wishes to prevent you from doing so, it can attempt a Will save, negating the spell on a success, but most animals don't bother to do so. While tapping into the target's senses, you can't use your own body's senses, but you can change back and forth from your body's senses to the target's senses using a Sustain action.

spell->Curse of Lost Time.name: Curse of Lost Time
spell->Curse of Lost Time.description:
You curse the target with rapid aging or erosion. The effect depends on whether the target is an object, a construct, or a living creature. Artifacts, along with objects and constructs made of precious materials (as determined by the GM), are immune.

  • Object If the object is attended, its bearer can attempt a Fortitude save. If the bearer fails or the object is unattended, the object immediately takes 4d6 damage (applying Hardness normally) and the item is cursed with an unlimited duration. Until the curse ends, the item becomes shoddy and can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repaired}, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the object's Hit Points. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} can target an item affected by this spell.
  • Construct The construct takes 4d6 damage (basic Fortitude save). On a failure, for 1 hour the construct is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, and can't be Repaired, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the construct's Hit Points. On a critical failure, these effects have an unlimited duration.
  • Living Creature The living creature must attempt a Fortitude save. Ageless creatures are immune.
    • Critical Success The living creature is unaffected.
    • Success The living creature briefly ages, becoming clumsy 1 and enfeebled 1 for 1 round.
    • Failure As success, with a duration of 1 hour.
    • Critical Failure As success, with an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
spell->Curse of Lost Time.target: 1 Large or smaller object, construct, or living creature

spell->Fireball.name: Fireball
spell->Fireball.description:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Slow.name: Slow
spell->Slow.description:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Speak with Plants (Constant).name: Speak with Plants (Constant)
spell->Speak with Plants (Constant).description:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Veil of Privacy.name: Veil of Privacy
spell->Veil of Privacy.description: You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. Veil of privacy attempts to counteract all detection, revelation, and scrying effects used against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects for only veil of privacy's target.

spell->Animal Messenger.name: Animal Messenger
spell->Animal Messenger.description:
You offer food, and an ordinary Tiny animal within range approaches to eat it. You imprint the image, direction, and distance of an obvious place or landmark well known to you within the animal. You can also attach a small object or note up to light Bulk to it. The animal does its best to reach the destination; if it makes it there, it waits nearby and allows nonhostile creatures to approach and remove the attached object. The spell ends after the message is delivered or after 24 hours, whichever comes first.

If there are no Tiny wild animals in range, the spell is lost.

spell->One with Plants.name: One with Plants
spell->One with Plants.description:
You can either transform into a plant or merge with plant matter. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the plant, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the plant. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Plants The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a plant with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the plant. If the plant takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the plant and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the plant.
  • Turn into a Plant The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large plant—typically a tree. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a plant that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a plant, your AC is 20, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures

spell->Revealing Light.name: Revealing Light
spell->Revealing Light.description:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

spell->Sound Body.name: Sound Body
spell->Sound Body.description:
You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add petrified and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.

spell->Speak with Animals (Constant).name: Speak with Animals (Constant)
spell->Speak with Animals (Constant).description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

spell->Water Walk.name: Water Walk
spell->Water Walk.description:
The target can walk on the surface of water and other liquids without falling through. It can go underwater if it wishes, but in that case it must Swim normally. This spell doesn't grant the ability to breathe underwater.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, the duration increases to 1 hour, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Alarm.name: Alarm
spell->Alarm.description:
You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the mental trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the auditory trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:15] check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a Stealth check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

Heightened (3rd) You can specify a trigger for which types of creatures sound the alarm spell.

spell->Charm.name: Charm
spell->Charm.description:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Guidance.name: Guidance
spell->Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

spell->Heal.name: Heal
spell->Heal.description:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

spell->Know the Way.name: Know the Way
spell->Know the Way.description:
In your mind's eye, you magically reorient yourself. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location), and you can choose a location you were at within the last 24 hours and learn what direction it lies.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose a location you were at within the last week.

Heightened (7th) You can choose a location you were at regardless of how long ago you were there.

spell->Light.name: Light
spell->Light.description:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

spell->Light.name: Light
spell->Light.description:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

spell->Pest Form.name: Pest Form
spell->Pest Form.description:
You transform into the battle form of a Tiny animal, such as a cat, insect, lizard, or rat. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as a rat or praying mantis), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the animal trait and you can't make Strikes. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities:

  • AC = 15 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • Speed 20 feet.
  • Weakness 5 to physical damage. (If you take physical damage in this form, you take 5 additional damage.)
  • Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.
  • Acrobatics and Stealth modifiers of +10, unless your own modifier is higher; Athletics modifier -4.

Heightened (4th) You can turn into a flying creature, such as a bird, which grants you a fly Speed of 20 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ydsLEGjY89Akc4oZ]{Spell Effect: Pest Form}

spell->Stabilize.name: Stabilize
spell->Stabilize.description: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

spell->Tailwind.name: Tailwind
spell->Tailwind.description:
The wind at your back pushes you to find new horizons. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PQHP7Oph3BQX1GhF]{Spell Effect: Tailwind}

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.7vIUF5zbvHzVcJA0]{Spell Effect: Tailwind (8 hours)}

spell->Tangle Vine.name: Tangle Vine
spell->Tangle Vine.description:
A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

spell->Vanishing Tracks (At Will).name: Vanishing Tracks (At Will)
spell->Vanishing Tracks (At Will).description:
You obscure the tracks you leave behind. The DC of checks to Track you gains a +4 status bonus or is equal to your spell DC, whichever results in a higher DC.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 8 hours. The spell has a range of 20 feet and targets up to 10 creatures.

action->Summer Bound.name: Summer Bound
action->Summer Bound.description: During the winter months, a summer hora can't take reactions, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and can't reduce their sickened condition below 1.

action->Tied to the Land.name: Tied to the Land
action->Tied to the Land.description: A summer hora queen is intrinsically tied to a specific region, such as a forest or hilly plain. For 3 months around the summer solstice, the environment is supernaturally resilient, allowing the queen to automatically attempt to counteract spells and rituals that would harm the environment, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight}, with a [[/r 1d20+27 #Counteract]]{+27} counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 7. For the 3 months around the winter solstice, however, her warded region becomes twisted or unhealthy unless a winter hora queen is present.

action->Nymph's Beauty.name: Nymph's Beauty
action->Nymph's Beauty.description: 30 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the emanation must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 minute.

action->Change Shape.name: Change Shape
action->Change Shape.description:
A summer hora queen can transform between her original form, which looks much like a typical nymph of her kind, and any Small or Medium humanoid form, typically choosing a version of her natural form that more closely resembles a humanoid

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Focus Beauty.name: Focus Beauty
action->Focus Beauty.description:
Requirements The target creature is affected by the summer hora queen's nymph's beauty aura

Effect The required creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its sight is restored via sound body or a similar effect, or until the summer hora queen chooses to remove the effect using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

action->Inspiration.name: Inspiration
action->Inspiration.description:
A nymph queen can inspire a single intelligent creature by giving that creature a token of her favor, typically a lock of her hair. As long as the creature carries her token and remains in good standing with the nymph queen, the creature gains a +1 status bonus to all Crafting checks, Performance checks, and Will saves.

If a nymph queen grants her Inspiration to a bard and the nymph queen is that bard's muse, the bard gains an additional benefit depending on their muse theme: for lore muse, the bard also gains a +1 status bonus to all Lore checks; for maestro muse, the status bonus to Performance checks increases to +2 for the purpose of determining the effects of compositions; for polymath muse, the bard gains a +4 status bonus to untrained skill checks; and for all other muses, the Will save bonus increases to +2 against fey.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.iSyyR4QVOaY6mxtg]{Effect: Nymph Queen's Inspiration}

action->Summer's Salvation.name: Summer's Salvation
action->Summer's Salvation.description:
Trigger The summer hora queen or an ally within 30 feet that the summer hora queen can see fails a Perception check, saving throw, attack roll, or skill check.

Effect The hora's or ally's check gains a retroactive status bonus, which can change the outcome from a critical failure to a failure or a failure to a success. This bonus is +2 in summer, increasing to +4 if it's within 14 days of the summer solstice. In spring or autumn, the bonus is +1, and in winter this ability has no effect. The summer hora can't use Summer's Rescue again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Summer's Rescue]]{1d4 rounds}.

Svartalfar First Blade.name: Svartalfar First Blade
Svartalfar First Blade.publicNotes:
Svartalfar first blades head guilds of svartalfar assassins, earning their position as the most skilled in the ways of the blade. Once in this position of leadership, a first blade is always one misstep away from being usurped.

In the First World's first few centuries, even before the full creation of the Universe, svartalfars lived among the other fey. No records exist of their exact appearance at that time, though many scholars believe they had typical elven features. At some point in the distant past, the majority of these svartalfars participated in some unknown heinous acts, and their entire people were summarily exiled to the Netherworld. That shadowy plane soon warped svartalfars in both body and mind, turning their skin pale gray and hairless and their thoughts cruel and practical. Present-day svartalfars are born with some innate shadow magic.

Svartalfar communities in the Netherworld are small, featuring tall, slender buildings and subterranean chambers. The largest structures are operated by powerful guilds of assassins and bounty hunters that the community takes great pride in. Guild members are deadly serious about any contracts they agree upon, working with brutal efficiency to find (and often dispose of) their targets. When a svartalfar fails to complete their mission, they are usually publicly executed by their kin.

spell->Haste.name: Haste
spell->Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

spell->Invisibility (Self Only).name: Invisibility (Self Only)
spell->Invisibility (Self Only).description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Invisibility (Self Only).name: Invisibility (Self Only)
spell->Invisibility (Self Only).description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Gouging Claw.name: Gouging Claw
spell->Gouging Claw.description:
You temporarily morph your limb into a clawed appendage. Make a melee spell attack roll against your target's AC. If you hit, you deal your choice of 2d6 slashing damage or 2d6 piercing damage, plus 2 persistent bleed damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage and double bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

spell->Ignition.name: Ignition
spell->Ignition.description:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}

spell->Sure Strike.name: Sure Strike
spell->Sure Strike.description:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

action->Deadly Blade.name: Deadly Blade
action->Deadly Blade.description:
Requirements The svartalfar first blade is unnoticed by a creature

Effect The svartalfar first blade makes a rapier Strike against a creature they're unnoticed by, hoping to kill them from the shadows. If the Strike hits, the target takes an additional 6d6 precision damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic] save. If the Strike was a critical success, the result of the target's saving throw is one degree worse.

action->Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
action->Quick Draw.description: The svartalfar first blade Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

action->Shadow Step.name: Shadow Step
action->Shadow Step.description: The svartalfar first blade fades into shadow, Strides up to twice its Speed, and reforms. This movement doesn't trigger reactions, but the svartalfar killer must begin and end in an area of dim light or darkness.

Svartalfar Killer.name: Svartalfar Killer
Svartalfar Killer.publicNotes:
Svartalfar killers are bounty hunters and mercenaries. They prefer to stalk their prey from the shadows until the time is right to strike. Svartalfar killers employ a direct approach once their chosen victim is alone or otherwise vulnerable.

action->Magical Flurry.name: Magical Flurry
action->Magical Flurry.description: The svartalfar makes a melee Strike, then casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MPxbKoR54gkYkqLO]{Gouging Claw} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition} targeting the same creature as the Strike. Apply their multiple attack penalty to the attacks normally. If both attacks hit, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the svartalfar's next turn.

action->Shadow Step.name: Shadow Step
action->Shadow Step.description: The svartalfar killer fades into shadow, Strides up to twice its Speed, and reforms. This movement doesn't trigger reactions, but the svartalfar killer must begin and end in an area of dim light or darkness.

action->Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
action->Sneak Attack.description: A svartalfar killer deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Svartalfar Shadowskein.name: Svartalfar Shadowskein
Svartalfar Shadowskein.publicNotes:
Svartalfar who hone their connection to the Netherworld might train as shadowskeins, manipulators of shadow and darkness. Shadowskeins tap into the occult power of shadows to create umbral illusions.
